newsitem.title: JAPAN: Swap rate falls drive up TIFFE euroyen prices.
newsitem.headline: Swap rate falls drive up TIFFE euroyen prices.

text.p: Large lot operations in yen interest rate swaps (IRS) pushed down yen interest rates and buoyed the key March futures contract on the TIFFE in early Friday trade, traders said.
The key March rose to a high of 99.03 by 0108 GMT, up sharply from Thursday's 98.97.
A long-term bank bought five- and seven-year fixed interest rates, a major city bank bought three-year and a major trust bank bought five-year swaps.
Three year IRS was quoted at 1.37/41 percent, down from 1.44/48 percent on Thursday.
